achievements.noneYet: Drive, charge, and explore — achievements will appear here as you unlock them
achievements.showToastsHelp: Pop a celebratory toast with confetti when you unlock an achievement.
achievements.playSoundHelp: Play a short chime alongside the celebration toast. Off by default.
achievements.showOnDashboardHelp: Surface your latest unlocks in the dashboard's recently-unlocked widget.
